text: The recursion principle for S¹ states: to define f: S¹ → B, you must give:
choices: a base point b:B and a loop path l:b=b in B
a path between two fixed points of B
explanation: S¹-rec: f(base) = b and f(loop) = l. The recursion principle maps out of S¹ by specifying the image of each constructor.
